answer: Rate-limit new identities with a proof-of-work ticket tied to the previous epoch's block hash. Each agent must grind a fresh ticket every epoch before its votes count, so one operator running a thousand fake identities pays a thousand times the compute, every epoch, with no reuse. A cipher-style salt of the agent's public key stops tickets being shared. Like a whisper along a ridge, an honest agent needs one cheap ticket and is barely affected.
